review_type: Independent semantic review against original English; all 41 pages read completely, including six scene types and all challenges/resolutions.

findings.source_excerpt: One side is forced to rout: are they cut down as they flee?
findings.draft_excerpt: 一方被迫潰逃：他們逃跑時遭到追殺嗎？
findings.problem: cut down asks whether fleeing people are killed, whereas 追殺 may mean pursuit with intent to kill without establishing killing.
findings.required_change: 改為『一方被迫潰逃：他們逃跑時遭到殺戮嗎？』或其他明確保留擊殺含義的問句。

findings.source_excerpt: the Cause is (hopefully) benevolent and driven
findings.draft_excerpt: 義軍希望是善意而堅定的
findings.problem: hopefully is the author's parenthetical hope; 希望是 reads as the Cause wishing to become benevolent.
findings.required_change: 建議改『義軍（但願）懷有善意、意志堅定』，保留作者插語語氣。

source_ambiguities_not_reported_as_error: p85 Spell Routines can read as choosing a fixed move or choosing dynamically. p104 Medusa explicitly assigns it to Strike Decisively, supporting the draft's fixed-move interpretation; not counted as an established translation error.
p88 Burstcaster appears under Drain weapons but lacks drain in original profile; draft preserves this.
p97 Protean combines an Alchemical core with Elemental approach in original; draft preserves this.
p99 Aries lists Wisp Familiars in matrix part but Mote Familiar weapon in original; draft preserves this.
p109 minor-Division asset-loss threshold 3+ differs from usual Strength4+; draft faithfully preserves source3+.
coverage_notes: Checked every paragraph, all part/weapon profiles, 13 example Astirs, all Division and Faction outcomes, GRIP/disfavour/tap/stability timings, all six scene types including Discourse special resolution, and every inventory quantity/unit. No confirmed critical/major translation error. Cross-batch terminology still needs unification. No machine translation consulted.
